observed.description:
Visitors see a generic page. Make it feel personal.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC01: The page loads in under two seconds
- AC02: The page works without JavaScript
- AC03: Visiting the home page shows "Hello, <name>" for a signed-in visitor
- AC04: A visitor who is not signed in sees "Hello, friend" instead of an empty name

## Notes
Keep the current colours.

## Decisions
- Which pages should greet the visitor by name? — Only the home page
- Not now:
  - The greeting is readable on a 375px wide phone screen without scrolling sideways
